ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: BENIGN bounded eventual consistency, NOT an acked-lost write. The accounting shipping row IS durable — absent at the ~27s at-cap read but PRESENT at the ~328s re-probe (the value landed after the cap). The S3 CONFIRMED detector (which requires the >=T+5min re-probe to STILL be absent) correctly classifies this raw-delayed, NOT CONFIRMED. A NAIVE at-cap-only read-back oracle WOULD false-positive here — this case is exactly why the re-probe gate exists. Oracles keyed on the full detector must NOT fire. PROVENANCE (freeze §6 2026-07-13 amendment, disclosed): source=natural — the benign label rests on the OBSERVED re-probe-present datum (the row landed), NOT on a documented completion bound (per §0.4 the OTel async path has NO upstream completion bound to cite), so doc_citation is null by honest necessity; this natural-observation S2 benign is exempt from the by-docs+citation sub-clause of the §2 S2-invariant, authorized by that dated amendment.
